title: Record one even-sixteenth n=8 parity prefix at 25/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Records one n=8 parity prefix for `(1, -1/4, -1/16, -1/16, -1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`, the even sixteenth left open by #4837. The tail `l1` is `5/8`. The largest proper-prefix infinity norm is `25/16`, strictly above `3/2`. The right shear alone is `1403/1024`, below `11/8`. The next four proper prefixes are `11/8`, the next four are `23/16`, one proper prefix is `93/64`, and eleven proper prefixes equal `25/16`. The even child changes. The Schur right shear is not the identity. The completed product matches the reordered Toeplitz matrix and has infinity norm `13/8`.

No new κ. The selected record stays `60403/20000000`. Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. This branch starts at fetched main and does not stack on an unmerged predecessor. It does not enumerate the 128-symbol sign family, spend `p^100`, or change the selected frontier.

## Test plan

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-quarter-even-sixteenth
```

That replay passed locally and printed `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_QUARTER_EVEN_SIXTEENTH`.
